crossRefs.note: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
It will happen that after I have plucked them up, I will return and have compassion on them. I will bring them again…
Tear your heart, and not your garments, and turn to Yahweh, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger…
Who knows? He may turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal offering and a drink offering to…
Therefore Yahweh says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says Yahweh of Armies…
How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
For Yahweh will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
So Yahweh turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.
For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone; that…
“How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you…
Yahweh relented concerning this. “It shall not be,” says Yahweh.
Yahweh relented concerning this. “This also shall not be,” says the Lord Yahweh.
Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?”

translations.web: Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
translations.bsb: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.
translations.kjv: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
translations.asv: Return, O Jehovah; how long? And let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
